summary: The DFM Ratios formula bar has a new paste control that turns an Excel workbook path and range on the clipboard into a linked formula.
details: Paste accepts a bare or '='-prefixed reference, quoted or unquoted, including one embedded in a larger formula, and rewrites it into the canonical form.
Clipboard text without a workbook path is reported in the formula-bar tooltip and leaves the cell unchanged.
The paste, refresh, and open-workbook controls now use matching stroke SVG icons and the shared ArcRho tooltip instead of native browser tooltips.
